_comment: The five gods of LiDollQuest Online (FAITH_DESIGN.md). Export with python/export_online_gods.py to the service's server/gods-data.json; the client reads this file directly for the HUD and its client-side blessings. Piety runs 0..piety_max; blessings scale with piety / piety_max. Uniform rules are checked on every committed turn; breaking them is anathema.
creation_intro: Five gods watch over the kingdom, and each keeps a temple in one of its towns. Follow one and you earn piety by living the way they ask, which grows into a blessing. Your first vow is free, now or later at any temple. Swearing to a different god afterwards costs a tribute of 1 diamond or 5 stars.

start_hubs.label: Honeydew Village
start_hubs.blurb: A lantern-lit farming village where nobody minds a little mess. The Community Hall and Inn are steps from the square, Bramble sells reagents, and the gentle Autumnal Plains lie just south for your first trips outside.
perks: Inn beds and a Community Hall
Gates to the Plains, Tundra, Desert and Haunted Woods

start_hubs.label: Rose Court
start_hubs.blurb: A walled courtyard garden at the foot of the Castle. Sleep in the Castle dormitory, visit the market, and brave the Princess' Quarters Dive when you feel ready. Sable's quiet sanctum waits inside the Castle.
perks: Market and the Princess' Quarters Dive

start_hubs.label: LittleBigCity
start_hubs.blurb: A clockwork city of storefronts and avenues. Merchants trade behind labelled shopfronts, the Inn and the Clockwork Coliseum face the plaza, and the Seafoam Coast begins at the south gate.
perks: Gates to the Desert and the Coast

start_hubs.label: Utopia
start_hubs.blurb: A magitek city where diapers are simply how people dress. Free Auto-Changing Stations and Nap Pods sit in every building, and Padded Pride means nobody will look twice at a crinkle. Sula's temple is here.
perks: Free changers and nap pods everywhere

start_hubs.label: Arcadia
start_hubs.blurb: An industrial city of bigs that runs on Big Rules: scrutiny at the door, pay toilets, and a little tax on anything childish. The Iron Chapel of Orthain rewards those who keep themselves together. A tougher start.
perks: Pay toilets and the shift whistle
Smog, scrutiny and a little tax

gods.name: Orthain
gods.philosophy: A person should be self-sufficient. Staying little is refusal, not rest.

priest.name: High Warden Stellan
priest.line: Orthain asks nothing you cannot give: stand on your own feet, dress as the adult you are, and keep your body in hand. Kneel here if you mean it.

gods.blessing_text: Stamina drains up to 50% slower; melee damage up to +20%.

gods.name: Sula
gods.philosophy: Peace is found by letting go. Nobody should be too good to be little, or to ask a friend for help.

priest.name: Mother Lull
priest.line: Shh, shh. You don't have to hold on so tight any more, sweetpea. Sula catches everyone who lets go.

gods.blessing_text: From 50 piety, crawling costs no speed or damage; magic damage up to +20%.

gods.name: Nyx
gods.philosophy: Truth begins with openness. Feel no shame, and present your best features for all to see.

priest.name: Oracle Vesna
priest.line: Hiding is a kind of lie, darling. Nyx wants to see all of you: the lace, the padding, the blush. Especially the blush.

gods.blessing_text: Defense up to +20%; physical damage up to +15%.

gods.name: Sable
gods.philosophy: The under-layer is not public property. Flash is theft. Respect is a finished outer garment.

priest.name: Canoness Merrow
priest.line: Cover yourself, and change only where it is proper to change. What is beneath is between you and Sable alone.

gods.blessing_text: Diapers hold up to 2 more before leaking; up to a 5% chance an accident uses no capacity.

gods.name: Orin
gods.philosophy: Humanity has no need of the gods' laws. Live your life, and show how foolish those who blindly obey really are.

priest.name: Freebrother Tam
priest.line: No rules here, friend. Well, one: nobody locks you into anything. Go show the pious how silly their little uniforms are.

gods.blessing_text: Break free of cursed gear up to 3 times a day, anywhere; Cursebreaker prices up to 50% off. Locked in cursed gear, Orin's blessing fails and piety drains.
